name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
eligibility_facts: individuals, SHGs, FPOs, FCOs, JLGs, Section 8 companies listed
50% capital subsidy in stated sub-mission, max ₹25 lakh/unit per source
hard_exclusions: no subsidy for working capital, vehicles, land purchase or lease costs in stated sub-mission
questions: Which livestock activity do you want to start—poultry, goat, sheep, piggery, or fodder?
Are you applying as an individual, SHG, FPO, cooperative, JLG, or company?
temporal_note: Source describes a specific sub-mission; component-level eligibility should be preserved.

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: individuals, SHGs, FPOs, FCOs, JLGs, Section 8 companies listed

question.en: Are you applying as an individual, SHG, FPO, farmer cooperative, JLG, or Section 8 company?
question.or: ଆପଣ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି, SHG, FPO, ଚାଷୀ ସମବାୟ, JLG କିମ୍ବା Section 8 କମ୍ପାନୀ ଭାବେ ଆବେଦନ କରୁଛନ୍ତି କି?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: 50% capital subsidy in stated sub-mission, max ₹25 lakh/unit per source

description.en: The stated sub-mission provides a 50% capital subsidy up to ₹25 lakh per unit; this is benefit information.
description.or: ଉଲ୍ଲେଖିତ ଉପ-ମିଶନରେ ପ୍ରତି ୟୁନିଟ୍ ସର୍ବାଧିକ ₹୨୫ ଲକ୍ଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ୫୦% ପୁଞ୍ଜି ସବସିଡି ରହିଛି; ଏହା ଲାଭ ସୂଚନା।

description.en: Bank appraisal, financing, and the applicant's project contribution must be confirmed separately.
description.or: ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ, ଅର୍ଥାୟନ ଏବଂ ଆବେଦକଙ୍କ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଅଂଶଦାନକୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] no subsidy for working capital, vehicles, land purchase or lease costs in stated sub-mission

description.en: The stated sub-mission does not subsidize working capital, vehicles, land purchase, or lease costs.
description.or: ଉଲ୍ଲେଖିତ ଉପ-ମିଶନରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାରୀ ପୁଞ୍ଜି, ଯାନବାହନ, ଜମି କ୍ରୟ କିମ୍ବା ଲିଜ୍ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ପାଇଁ ସବସିଡି ମିଳେ ନାହିଁ।
